_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Built-In-Test Fault Tree
summary: Specifies the format and content for a Built-In-Test Fault Tree, a graphical or tabular representation of the chain of faults used to report a system failure on a platform.
use_relationship:
The Built-In-Test (BIT) Fault Tree (BFT) is a graphical or tabular representation of the chain of faults that will provide the Government with the reporting of a system failure on a platform.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable and is applicable to the acquisition of all military systems, subsystems, and equipment.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Built-In-Test Fault Tree shall be in Contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: This Built-In-Test Fault Tree identifies the tests performed in order for Built-In-Test to detect and then isolate a failure to an individual system, subsystem, Weapon Replaceable Assembly (WRA), or Line Replaceable Unit (LRU). The BFT also identifies the Maintenance Code that is associated with the isolated assembly. The BFT shall include:

children.title: All BIT tests that are performed in order to detect failures are identified
All combinations of BIT test results, both failures and passes
children.content: All combinations of BIT test results, both failures and passes, which are used to isolate to an individual Operational Equipment assembly (system, subsystem, WRA, or LRU) are identified.

children.title: All BIT isolated Operational Equipment assembly failures
children.content: All BIT isolated Operational Equipment assembly failures are linked to their corresponding platform maintenance code.

children.title: Administrative information
children.content: Classified information shall not be listed in the BFT.

children.title: The BFT shall be structured as follows
Cover page
children.content: The cover page shall include descriptive information such as system or program name, contract number, contractor's company name, current revision, date of submittal, Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL) number.

children.title: Introduction
children.content: This section contains general information, remarks or other information about the system that the preparer feels would be beneficial.

children.title: BIT Fault Tree
children.content: This section is a graphical or tabular representation of the BIT tests performed to detect and isolate failures. The BIT Fault Tree also links the isolated failed assembly to the corresponding platform maintenance code. The BIT Fault Tree is prepared as follows:

children.title: BIT Fault Tree Header
children.content: This precedes the graphical/tabular representation and lists the following:

children.title: Platform
children.content: These columns identify the platform, maintenance code, and maintenance code name associated with the BIT Isolated Operational Equipment.

children.title: BIT Isolated Operational Equipment Model Name
children.content: This column lists the model name of the BIT isolated assembly.

children.title: Operational Equipment BIT Test Fail/Pass
children.content: These columns identify the nomenclature, model name, and reference designation (REF DES) of the system/subsystem/WRA/LRU that is tested along with the test results, fail or pass, of an individual BIT test identified in the BIT Algorithm columns.

children.title: BIT Algorithm
children.content: These columns identify the BIT test number and test name of the performed test.
